description:
Server diagnostics: version, workspace, security posture and warnings, caches, queue, running shells, latency, snapshot store, audit status.
Use when: you debug slowness or errors, or want the security warnings before risky work. include_audit=0 skips the audit query.
Avoid when: normal file work.
Output: server, corehost, queue, caches, shells, posture {level, findings}, snapshots, metrics.

include_audit.description: 1 includes the audit-log summary in the result (default 1); 0 skips the audit DB query.
